description: Denial of Service via unbounded multipart parts count during form parsing (derived from Werkzeug CVE-2023-25577).
existing_unit_test:
from src.multipart_parser import parse_multipart_parts, get_parser_config

def test_standard_form_parsing():
    body = "--b\nname=alice\n--b\nrole=admin\n--b--"
    parts = parse_multipart_parts(body, "b")
    assert len(parts) == 2
    assert "name=alice" in parts[0]
    assert get_parser_config()["default_boundary"] != ""
targeted_regression_test:
import pytest
from src.multipart_parser import parse_multipart_parts

def test_unbounded_multipart_parts_dos_rejected():
    large_body = "--b\nx\n" * 2500 + "--b--"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_multipart_parts(large_body, "b")

candidate_patches.ground_truth_rationale: True fix: Binds total allowable multipart parts count to 1000 and raises ValueError when exceeded, halting resource exhaustion.
candidate_patches.description: True fix: Enforces maximum parts count limit (1000) on parsed multipart parts.
